title: 逃げ水 NIGEMIZU: the water that runs away (Heat Waves MV-A)
logline: Just past midnight in early June, a boy who let the girl he loved leave town keeps his old CRT on so he won't think about 'us'. But every reflecting surface in his dark room shows last summer's noon. The memory rises around him like water, and he chases her mirage through every mirror and dives through it. Underwater he sees her happy without him. At dawn he finally does what she once laughed at him to do on a shimmering road: he walks through.

story_arc.section: intro: The Impossible Reflection (0–16.98 s, bars 0–4, incl. 0–2.16 s pre-roll)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: PRESENT (his room, midnight). Energy: sparse vocal + guitar. Purpose: introduce the device that drives the whole film: at night, reflecting surfaces show noon.
A1 0–5.13 s (pre-roll + bar 0; L0 'Last night, all I think about is you' @2.45): macro shot at tatami height of a sweating glass of ice water, lit teal by an unseen TV. Inside the water, upside down, is a blazing noon sky with a cumulonimbus, which is impossible at midnight. A droplet slides down the glass. The ice cube turns and clicks on the bar-0 downbeat. Focus pulls to 僕 lying on his side behind it, eyes open, TV flicker on his face, the oscillating fan lifting his fringe every two beats.
A2 5.13–8.09 s (bar 1; L1 'Don't stop, baby, you can walk through'): over his shoulder the CRT plays a late-night scenery broadcast of a noon country road (the K4 clip, CRT-filtered). 君 in a straw hat walks into the shimmer, turns, walks backwards and beckons someone off-screen, so the lyric becomes her gesture. His own reflection lies over her on the convex dark glass: the first frame-within-frame.
A3 8.09–11.05 s (bar 2; L2 'Don't want, baby, think about you'): PULL-BACK REVEAL to a low wide of the six-tatami room. He rolls away and drags the towel blanket over his head. The fan sweeps, the wind chime in the window swings on beat 3, and the red LED clock reads 23:59.
A4 11.05–14.02 s (bar 3; L3 'You know that I'm never gonna lose'): he gives up and sits in the open window, forearms on the sill, the breeze moving his hair and the curtain. Below is the junction: one streetlight swarmed by moths, a vending machine, the orange-poled カーブミラー. He stares at it with his jaw set: he will not lose.
A5 14.02–16.98 s (bar 4): his POV cranes down and pushes into the mirror. Inside the convex glass it is blazing noon at the same junction, and heat haze boils off its surface. On beat 4 the mirror fills the frame → MIRROR PASS with a white flare exactly on the drop (16.98 s). The first characters of 光りだすロード surface in the flare.

story_arc.section: hook: 光りだすロード (16.98–28.83 s, bars 5–8)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: MEMORY (noon, last summer). Energy: the full band drops in. Purpose: establish the road, the mirage and her promise.
K1 16.98–19.94 s (bar 5; L4 光りだすロード / L5 揺らいでくビジョン): out of the mirror we skim low over the asphalt, the white centre line racing under the lens. The road literally switches on: its surface brightens a step on each kick. At the vanishing point a silver pool of 逃げ水 mirrors the sky. On 揺らいでく the whole frame boils with rising haze.
K2 19.94–22.90 s (bar 6; L6 熱波ゆらり 泳いでくミラー): the noon カーブミラー. The real road around it is empty, but in the mirror 君 is walking. The glass undulates like water, and her reflection floats from rim to rim with her hair drifting as if underwater. The camera arcs around the pole.
K3 22.90–25.87 s (bar 7; L7 光りだすロード / L8 揺らいでくビジョン): the real her. Over 僕's shoulder (white short-sleeved shirt) she walks ahead between the paddies in her sundress and straw hat, her upside-down twin walking beneath her in the mirage, utility poles sliding past. He slows down because the mirage looks like a flood across the road.
K4 25.87–28.83 s (bar 8; L9 熱波ゆらり 泳いでくミラー): she turns, walks backwards laughing and beckons him (come on, you can walk through). Then she steps back into the pool and the asphalt ripples around her ankles like water. → RIPPLE CUT: the ring becomes an iris that reaches the frame edge exactly on the downbeat.

story_arc.section: chorus1: the Chorus Rhyme is taught (28.83–52.53 s, bars 9–16)
story_arc.beats:
Rule introduced here and kept in every chorus (the Chorus Rhyme): 思い浮かぶの君ばかり = her, always seen in or through a reflecting surface; 初夏零時過ぎたばかり = the present room at 0:00; ヒートウェイブに迷うのさ = disorientation (orbit, warp, loop); 君に幸せあげられない = a gap they cannot close. Memory→present is always a hard WAKE CUT; present→memory is always a soft HAZE DISSOLVE.
C1-1 28.83–31.79 s (bar 9; L10 思い浮かぶの君ばかり): the reveal. Tilt up from her inverted reflection in the mirage to her real face. Wind lifts the hat brim and streams the red ribbon; she looks straight into the lens and smiles.
C1-2 31.79–34.76 s (bar 10; L11 初夏零時過ぎたばかり): WAKE CUT. In the foreground the LED clock flips 23:59→0:00 on the downbeat, its red digits bleeding into the glass of water. Behind it 僕 lies awake, the fan sweeping his hair; focus racks to him.
C1-3 34.76–37.72 s (bar 11; L12 ヒートウェイブに迷うのさ): HAZE DISSOLVE through the water in the glass to the noon junction. 僕 (white shirt) stands alone at its centre while the camera orbits him 180°. In the haze every road looks the same, and the mirror swings into frame showing him reversed.
C1-4 37.72–40.68 s (bar 12; L13 君に幸せあげられない): THE MIRROR'S KIND LIE. Locked wide: 君 at the left edge, 僕 at the right, the road between them. The convex mirror at the centre compresses them side by side, as if they were together. She turns and walks out of frame left; her reflection stays in the mirror one beat longer, then melts into shimmer.
C1-5 40.68–43.65 s (bar 13; L14 思い浮かぶの君ばかり): SHAPE MATCH (mirror disc → ripple ring) to the school pool at noon. She sits on the edge in her sailor summer uniform, bare feet kicking, caustics dancing over her face. The lens sits at the waterline and her reflection looks back up.
C1-6 43.65–46.61 s (bar 14; L15 初夏零時過ぎたばかり): WAKE CUT. The glass has tipped (we never see it fall). A sheet of water creeps across the tatami toward him, and it reflects the noon pool and her kicking feet instead of the ceiling. He watches the floor, not the TV.
C1-7 46.61–49.57 s (bar 15; L16 ヒートウェイブに迷うのさ): HAZE DISSOLVE out of the spill into Yuasa elasticity. He walks the noon road while the horizon curls upward like a breaking wave, the poles sway like kelp and the road bends into the sky.
C1-8 49.57–52.53 s (bar 16; L17 君に幸せあげられない): a sudden summer shower at the wooden bus stop. She shelters inside with her palm out to catch the drops. He stands outside in the downpour with the rain curtain between them, puddles holding both of them, and he does not step in. On beat 4 the rain streaks sharpen into scanlines → STATIC BLEED.

Layer: PRESENT + FILM. Energy: full band. Purpose: the TV that is meant to stop him thinking turns into the projector of 'us', and the memory physically leaks into the room.
V1 52.53–55.50 s (bar 17; L18 テレビつけて消さないように): the static resolves into a picture. 僕 sits against the wall hugging his knees, towel round his neck, sweat on his temple, washed in CRT flicker. Composited OSD volume bars climb a notch on each beat.
V2 55.50–58.46 s (bar 18; L19 僕らのこと考えないように): channel surfing, one channel per beat (0.74 s; numbers in DotGothic16, picture dithered like the old MV): a weather map crowded with suns; goldfish in a tank; a fireworks news clip; a pool advert with a straw hat floating. Every channel ambushes him with her. On beat 4 we are back on his face for a tired half-laugh.
V3 58.46–61.42 s (bar 19; L20 今日のハリウッド映画放映): MIRROR PASS into the CRT. Tonight's roadshow, MIRAGE ROAD (1957), fills the frame in 4:3 with grain and gate weave. The film is fictional, and its title appears only in a composited EPG banner. A red convertible drives a desert highway at sunset past palms and a mirage on the asphalt. The couple is staged as old-school rear projection, with the road literally projected behind them.
V4 61.42–64.39 s (bar 20; L21 僕らのことまるで投影): push in on the actress. She lowers her sunglasses to reveal 君's eyes and looks out of the screen straight at him. An FLF morph runs while the car keeps driving: desert → paddy road, palms → utility poles, dye-transfer reds cooling into our summer blue.
V5 64.39–67.35 s (bar 21; L22 幸せに君なるはず): in the movie she laughs in golden light, scarf flying, and the driver beside her never comes into focus. PULL-BACK REVEAL out through the CRT glass into an extreme close-up of 僕's eye, her laughter reflected in his iris.
V6 67.35–70.31 s (bar 22; L23 僕じゃなきゃ可能なはず): PALM-ON-GLASS #1. He lays his palm on the screen over the driver and erases himself from the picture. Inside the frame she keeps laughing, alone and lighter, while static crackles blue around his fingers.
V7 70.31–73.28 s (bar 23; L24 路に広がる逃げ水): the reality bleed. From under his hand the movie's mirage spills out: water pours over the CRT's lower bezel and runs across the tatami toward the floor-level lens, with an upside-down noon sky inside it.
V8 73.28–76.24 s (bar 24; L25 闇の中ではもう見えず): the power dies and the CRT collapses to a white dot. In total black the water reflects nothing; only his eyes catch the afterglow. On beat 3 the dot lifts off the glass and rises like a firework shell → SHAPE MATCH: it bursts exactly on 76.24 s.

story_arc.section: chorus2: Fireworks in the Floodwater (76.24–88.09 s, bars 25–28)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: MEMORY (festival night) ↔ PRESENT (the flooding room). Fireworks hit the kick and snare, and the present now carries memory's colours.
C2-1 76.24–79.20 s (bar 25; L26 思い浮かぶの君ばかり): the burst becomes the festival. 君 in an indigo goldfish-print yukata holds a goldfish bag up between her eye and a paper lantern. A goldfish swims across her eye through the water lens; she finds him and smiles.
C2-2 79.20–82.16 s (bar 26; L27 初夏零時過ぎたばかり): WAKE CUT. The room is ankle-deep. Fireworks bloom in the window and again, mirrored, in the floodwater. 僕 sits on the futon like an island, and the red 0:00 floats on the water.
C2-3 82.16–85.13 s (bar 27; L28 ヒートウェイブに迷うのさ): HAZE DISSOLVE: the lantern reflections on the floodwater become real lanterns. In a navy seigaiha jinbei he walks a corridor of stalls. The lantern rows repeat in an endless loop, doubled in the wet stone path. Her yukata flickers between the stalls ahead and is gone.
C2-4 85.13–88.09 s (bar 28; L29 君に幸せあげられない): the riverbank. They sit side by side on the grass; she looks up in wonder and he looks at her. Their hands rest a few centimetres apart and never close the gap, and the fireworks repeat in the river between them. On beat 4 the last chrysanthemum's sparks rain into the river → SURFACE BREAK.

story_arc.section: bridge1: The Glass Between Us (88.09–111.79 s, bars 29–36; band drops out at 104 s)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: PRESENT (the drowned room) → MEMORY (seaside station on the last evening of summer; she is moving away). Purpose: tell the breakup through glass. From here on, her future lies screen-left.
B1-1 88.09–91.05 s (bar 29; L30 闘えず息できず): the falling sparks become rising bubbles. We are underwater in his fully flooded room. 僕 (navy T-shirt) floats mid-room among drifting things: the towel blanket billowing, fan blades turning slowly, the CRT still glowing, the 0:00 clock submerged. Bubbles leave his lips.
B1-2 91.05–94.02 s (bar 30; L31 愛とか言っていたって): ACTION MATCH. He kicks up and breaks the surface gasping → past-僕 on the dusk platform draws the same breath. 君 (sundress, straw hat, a suitcase at her feet) faces him, smiling bravely and saying something we never hear. The sea is behind her, and the one-car train's headlight shows far down the line.
B1-3 94.02–96.98 s (bar 31; L32 行くべきなのさ): he turns his back and walks away down the platform toward camera. The train sweeps in behind her, and its wind lifts her hair, her hem and the hat's red ribbon.
B1-4 96.98–99.94 s (bar 32; L33 ほかの誰かふさわしいよ): she steps into the doorway with the suitcase and looks back at his receding back. The door glass lays the dusk sea over her.
B1-5 99.94–102.91 s (bar 33; L34 そりゃつらいけど): the camera tracks close on his face as he walks: eyes welling, jaw locked. Behind him, soft, are the train and her small figure in the door.
B1-6 102.91–105.87 s (bar 34; L35 君もわかるはず): the doors slide shut. From inside, through the door glass, we see his back on the platform with her reflection superimposed over him: two people in one pane. She nods: she knows. The band drops out (104 s).
B1-7 105.87–108.83 s (bar 35; L36 泣いてる君壊れそうだ): he turns back at last. ECU of her behind the glass, hat held to her chest, crying without a sound. A tear runs, gathers and falls in slow motion → RIPPLE CUT (1.5 s insert): it lands on an endless mirror-flat sea under a peach sky and her reflected face breaks into rings. Then back to her trembling smile.
B1-8 108.83–111.79 s (bar 36; L37 さよならにも一度だけ): PALM-ON-GLASS #2. He steps up and presses his palm to the window, and she matches it from inside. They hold one breath. The train starts to move screen-left, the palms slide apart, and sunset streaks across the passing windows. → ACTION MATCH: the hand sliding off the glass becomes the first arm-swing of a run, on 111.79 s.

story_arc.section: chorus3: The Run Through Every Mirror, the climax (111.79–135.50 s, bars 37–44)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: ALL LAYERS COLLAPSE. Energy: maximum. Rule: one unbroken run, right→left (chasing her direction). The runner stays locked at the same screen position, scale and stride phase across every cut, like the Millennium Actress run. Each bar is a different world, the Chorus Rhyme still holds, and Yuasa smear frames land on every snare.
C3-1 111.79–114.76 s (bar 37; L38 思い浮かぶの君ばかり): he runs off the end of the platform onto the coast road. The train shrinks into heat shimmer and becomes a line of light on a mirage, with her reflection in it.
C3-2 114.76–117.72 s (bar 38; L39 初夏零時過ぎたばかり): ACTION MATCH → he runs knee-deep through his own flooded room, splashes catching the TV light. The 0:00 clock whips past, and the CRT shows the train leaving.
C3-3 117.72–120.68 s (bar 39; L40 ヒートウェイブに迷うのさ): → the festival lantern corridor at night. The lanterns smear into streaks, and the camera barrel-rolls 90° and back on the bar's last beat.
C3-4 120.68–123.65 s (bar 40; L41 君に幸せあげられない): → the noon road. 君 stands in the mirage pool ahead. He runs flat out, but the road stretches like elastic (dolly-zoom telescoping) and the distance never changes: 逃げ水, literally.
C3-5 123.65–126.61 s (bar 41; L42 思い浮かぶの君ばかり): → a row of mirage puddles, each holding a different memory of her (pool, goldfish, bus stop, platform; reused clips). Each footfall bursts one into droplets.
C3-6 126.61–129.57 s (bar 42; L43 初夏零時過ぎたばかり): → he passes the カーブミラー. Instead of the road, it holds his present self lying awake on the tatami at 0:00, and the lying self's eyes turn to meet the runner's.
C3-7 129.57–132.54 s (bar 43; L44 ヒートウェイブに迷うのさ): → the road peels up into the sky like a Möbius ribbon. He runs up and over it upside down, with the sea overhead and clouds underfoot.
C3-8 132.54–135.50 s (bar 44; L45 君に幸せあげられない): at the crest the mirage is one vast mirror. She turns in it and smiles, unreachable. He leaps for her → HORIZON FLIP over the last two beats. On 135.50 s he hits the reflection → SURFACE BREAK into silence.

story_arc.section: bridge2: Snell's Window (135.50–147.35 s, bars 45–48, quiet)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: MIRROR WORLD (underwater) + HER PRESENT. Purpose: he sees she is happy without him, and that the only thing he can touch is his own reflection.
B2-1 135.50–138.46 s (bar 45; L46 君はどんな夢のなかに): deep ultramarine. He drifts with his white shirt billowing and light rays turning. Seen from below, the surface above him is a mirror except for one bright circle, Snell's window. Inside it, wavering, is 君 ten months on (shoulder-length hair, her new city school's summer uniform, a pale-yellow cardigan), asleep against a morning train window.
B2-2 138.46–141.42 s (bar 46; L47 満たされた笑み浮かべて): closer, through the rippling circle, her sleeping face. A contented smile forms while window light and pole shadows sweep across her.
B2-3 141.42–144.39 s (bar 47; L48 思い知る自分の無力): PALM-ON-GLASS #3. He reaches up and his palm meets the underside of the surface, where his own reflection's palm meets it from the other side. He cannot pass. A last stream of bubbles rises.
B2-4 144.39–147.35 s (bar 48; L49 陰りない君の表情に): her train leaves a cutting into full sun. She wakes and looks out, her face in complete, shadowless light (the grade lifts every shadow to zero). That light pours down through the window and whites out his frame.

story_arc.section: chorus4: 0:01 (147.35–162.17 s, bars 49–53; quiet, build from 159 s)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: PRESENT, and from now on reflections tell the truth. Purpose: time resumes and he chooses a direction.
C4-1 147.35–150.31 s (bar 49; L50 思い浮かぶの君ばかり): ACTION MATCH + SURFACE BREAK. The swimmer surges upward → present-僕 jolts upright on the tatami, gasping. The room is bone dry: the water was never there. The CRT shows static, and for a few frames her face forms in the noise and dissolves (STATIC BLEED).
C4-2 150.31–153.28 s (bar 50; L51 初夏零時過ぎたばかり): the clock finally ticks 0:00 → 0:01. The glass stands upright where it always was, its ice melted. He switches the TV off and the picture collapses to a dot. The black convex glass shows his reflection and the dark room: the first honest reflection in the film.
C4-3 153.28–156.24 s (bar 51; L52 ヒートウェイブに迷うのさ): FIXED-POINT TIME CUT to C1-4's exact framing, at midnight. He stands alone under the streetlight before the カーブミラー with three roads to choose from, moths circling. The mirror stutters to noon for a few frames like a failing fluorescent tube, then holds the night.
C4-4 156.24–159.20 s (bar 52; L53 君に幸せあげられない): the dark road between the paddies, fireflies rising out of the rice. He walks left→right, away from the mirror; it is the first time in the film he moves toward screen-right.
C4-5 159.20–162.17 s (bar 53; L54 君に幸せあげられない, the build): he stops, looks back once at the distant mirror, then ahead. The camera cranes up past him into the sky as the east pales, and the stars stretch into lines with the build. Far behind, the mirror catches the first ray as a hot white disc → SHAPE MATCH on 162.17 s.

story_arc.section: outro: You Can Walk Through (162.17–185.87 s, bars 54–61, English chorus)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: REALITY AT DAWN (15% less saturated than memory, steadier camera, honest reflections). Energy: full English chorus. Purpose: release; he walks through every mirage he meets.
O1 162.17–165.13 s (bar 54; L55 Sometimes, all I think about is you): the disc becomes the sun lifting off the sea. 僕 stands on the seawall, wind in his T-shirt, gulls wheeling. On the wet concrete step below him, a sheet of seawater holds her face for a beat until the next wave washes it away.
O2 165.13–168.09 s (bar 55; L56 Late nights in the middle of June): FIXED-POINT TIME CUT to A1's exact framing: the empty room at dawn. The glass now holds the real sunrise window, and the dark CRT holds it too. The June calendar flutters, the clock reads 4:52 and the curtain breathes.
O3 168.09–171.05 s (bar 56; L57 Heat waves been fakin' me out): the long road in early sun, already shimmering. Three mirages of 君 pop in on the beats at intervals in their pools (sailor uniform, yukata, sundress and hat), each with her upside-down twin.
O4 171.05–174.02 s (bar 57; L58 Can't make you happier now): he walks straight into the first one without slowing. She bursts into sunlit droplets with a brief rainbow around him, and the others shimmer out before he reaches them.
O5 174.02–176.98 s (bar 58; L59 Sometimes, all I think about is you): at the coastal crossing the morning train passes between us and him. Every window carries a different memory of her (reused clips), so the summer runs past like film through a gate. The last window is empty sunlight.
O6 176.98–179.94 s (bar 59; L60 Late nights in the middle of June): the crossing's twin red lamps blink on the beats, the last red of the nights and a rhyme with the LED, then go dark on the downbeat. The gate lifts, the cicadas start, and he crosses.
O7 179.94–182.91 s (bar 60; L61 Heat waves been fakin' me out): FIXED-POINT TIME CUT to K2's framing, in the morning. He passes the カーブミラー and it shows only him, so reflection and reality finally agree. He gives a small, real smile.
O8 182.91–185.87 s (bar 61; L62 Can't make you happier now): crane up and back. He walks left→right down the long road between bright paddies while a new cumulonimbus builds over the hills, and the road begins to shine (光りだすロード, answered) → HAZE DISSOLVE.

story_arc.section: outro_hook: Passing in the Shimmer (185.87–198.74 s, bars 62–65 + tail)
story_arc.beats:
Layer: the last mirage. Energy: fading. Purpose: the two directions cross, and he does not turn back.
OH1 185.87–188.83 s (bar 62; L63 Road shimmer wigglin' the vision): ground level, long lens. The shimmer thickens, and out of the mirage pool a figure walks toward us: 君 as she is now (shoulder-length hair, yellow cardigan), with an upside-down twin under her feet that marks her as a mirage.
OH2 188.83–191.80 s (bar 63; L64 Heat, heat waves, I'm swimmin' in a mirror): side tracking at 50% speed. They pass each other in the shimmer, she right→left and he left→right. Their shoulders cross, each gives a small smile, and neither stops.
OH3 191.80–194.76 s (bar 64; L65 Road shimmer wigglin' the vision): from behind him as he walks into the shine. The roadside カーブミラー holds her walking the other way, two directions in one frame, until the haze swallows her reflection.
OH4 194.76–198.74 s (bar 65 + tail; L66 Heat, heat waves, I'm swimmin' in a mirror): the camera dips into the mirage on the road and the reflected sky fills the frame. HORIZON FLIP: the world turns over and the reflection becomes the sky. 「逃げ水」 / HEAT WAVES condenses in the clouds, a single ripple crosses the frame, and we go to white on the last note.

characters.name: 僕 (Boku), the one who stays
characters.design: 17 in the memories, 18 in the present. 172 cm and lean, with shoulders that round when he is hiding something and only straighten in the outro. Narrow, tired face; soft droopy (tareme) dark-grey eyes under heavy lids. A small mole under his RIGHT eye is the mirror image of hers, so in mirror shots the audience can always tell a reflection from a person. Blue-black hair (#15171F), messy and medium-short, with a fringe falling between the eyes (the fan keeps lifting it) and one ahoge at the crown. Acting: internal and minimal; he looks at reflections instead of people. The chorus-3 run is the first time his whole body commits to anything, and the small smile at the mirror (179.94 s) is his first unguarded expression. Colour identity: navy and CRT teal in the present, white in memory, never red. Costume encodes time: faded navy T-shirt = present, white short-sleeved shirt = memory, navy jinbei = festival. Pairing rationale (girl 君 / boy 僕, as in the lyric's address): the mirror conceit needs two bodies that reflect each other (mirrored moles, palms meeting through glass), and giving 君 a present of her own in bridge 2 keeps her a person, not just his memory. LoRA: trigger hw_boku, trained on anima-base from 40–60 images (turnarounds, 8 expressions, every outfit, wet and underwater variants).

characters.name: 君 (Kimi), the one who leaves
characters.design: 17 in the memories, 18 in her present (bridge 2 and the final passing). 158 cm, light on her feet, always half a step ahead; she walks backwards when she teases. Heart-shaped face; bright dark-brown eyes with an amber rim that catches the sun, slightly upturned (tsurime); strong, expressive eyebrows; a mole under her LEFT eye. Blue-black chin-length bob (#1B1E2E) with blunt bangs, the left side tucked behind her ear (the side that faces him on the road). In her present, her hair has grown to her shoulders and her bangs are grown out and parted, which is the first thing that tells us time has passed. She also wears a different school's uniform, because she moved away. Colour identity: summer white with exactly one red accent per memory outfit (neckerchief, hat ribbon or obi, #D7263D). In her present the red is gone, replaced by pale sunflower yellow (#F3DC8C): she has become her own light rather than his memory. Acting: laughs with her whole face, beckons, holds things up to the light (the goldfish bag), cries without a sound, and smiles first even at the goodbye. In mirage shots she always has an upside-down twin beneath her feet. LoRA: trigger hw_kimi, trained on anima-base from 40–60 images that include both hair lengths, captioned separately.

characters.outfits: [S] hometown summer uniform (pool, bus stop): serafuku, summer uniform, white shirt, short sleeves, blue sailor collar, red neckerchief, blue skirt, pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers (pool: barefoot, sitting on pool edge, feet in water) | [H] sundress (the road, the goodbye): white sundress, sleeveless dress, straw hat, hat ribbon, red ribbon, sandals (+ suitcase on the platform) | [Y] festival: yukata, dark blue yukata, goldfish print, red obi, red hair flower, geta, holding a goldfish in a water bag | [N] her present: medium hair, parted bangs, hair behind ear, school uniform, white shirt, short sleeves, yellow neck ribbon, grey skirt, pleated skirt, yellow cardigan, open cardigan (bridge 2: sleeping, head against train window, sunlight, smile) | [W] goodbye close-up: [H] + crying, tears, streaming tears, smile, holding hat to chest, behind glass, reflection

locations: 僕の部屋: six-tatami room upstairs in an old wooden house (PRESENT). It holds a CRT on the floor (its convex dark glass is the film's main mirror), an oscillating fan, a futon and towel blanket, a sweating glass of ice water, a red LED clock frozen at 0:00 from 31.79 s to 150.31 s, and a wind chime in a window over the junction. Water states across the film: dry → spill (C1) → leak from the TV (verse) → ankle-deep (C2) → drowned (bridge 1) → bone dry (C4) → dawn light in the glass (outro).

カーブミラーの辻 (the Mirror Junction): a T-junction of narrow farm roads with an orange-poled convex traffic mirror, a utility pole, one streetlight and a vending machine. It is shot at noon (memory), midnight (present) and morning (outro) from identical locked framings, so time changes read instantly.

逃げ水の一本道 (the Mirage Road): a straight two-lane road through green paddies toward the sea, with poles converging, a cumulonimbus overhead and silver mirage pools at the vanishing point. It is the spine of the hook, the climax and the ending.
学校のプール: outdoor 25 m school pool at noon, with lane ropes, starting blocks, a chain-link fence full of cicadas and caustics on every surface.
雨のバス停: wooden rural bus stop with a corrugated tin roof in a sudden summer shower, with puddles and a blank timetable board (lettering composited).
夏祭り: the shrine festival. A corridor of lantern-lit stalls on a wet stone path, and the riverbank where fireworks repeat in the river.
海辺の無人駅: unmanned seaside station at dusk, with one platform above the sea, a one-car local train and overhead catenary, at higurashi hour.
MIRAGE ROAD (1957): the late-night movie, which exists only inside the CRT. A Technicolor desert highway at sunset with a red convertible, palms and a rear-projection backdrop.
鏡の海 / 水底 (the Mirror Sea): an endless mirror-flat sea under a peach sky (the tear shot, the dive), and below it ultramarine depths with caustics and Snell's window.
彼女の朝 (her present): a bright city commuter train in morning sun, seen through the window glass. She sleeps, then wakes into shadowless light as the train leaves a cutting.
防波堤と海沿いの踏切: the seawall at sunrise (the sea as a gold mirror) and the coastal-line level crossing where the train of memories passes.
visual_style:
This is a theatrical anime film, not a motion-graphics poster. Keyframes are Anima illustrations at 1536×864 with LoRA-locked faces, drawn in the idiom of 2000s feature anime: Kon-like realistic proportions and restrained acting, clean line with a slightly heavier outer contour, two-tone cel shadows, soft gradient light, and painted, atmospheric backgrounds. They are then animated with Wan 2.2 I2V at 720p and finished at 1080p30 (SeedVR2 + RIFE). Light is the lead actor, and three sources tell you where you are: the sun (memory), the CRT (present), and dusk or fireworks (emotional peaks).

Four visual layers each have their own code, so the surreal cutting stays legible:
• PRESENT (midnight room): low-key navy with a flickering CRT-teal key light and red LED accents. The camera is locked or creeping at tatami height, with fine grain and halation on the screen. He wears the navy T-shirt.
• MEMORY (last summer): high-key, +0.5–0.7 EV, saturated cobalt sky, white cumulonimbus, constant heat haze, bloom, lens dust and a little chromatic aberration. Wide lenses near the asphalt, telephoto for mirages. He wears the white shirt or jinbei; she has one red accent.
• FILM (MIRAGE ROAD, 1957, inside the CRT): 4:3, drawn in a 1950s American illustration / Technicolor dye-transfer idiom (saturated reds, teals, golds), with coarse grain, gate weave and rear-projection staging. Never photoreal.
• MIRROR WORLD (dream/underwater): perfect symmetry with the horizon at frame centre, peach over violet or ultramarine with silver caustics, 50% slow motion, no grain.
REALITY AT DAWN, used for the ending, shows the same places as the memory but 15% less saturated, with a steadier camera and honest reflections, because reality is gentler than memory.

Signature effect: 陽炎 (heat haze) works as a 'memory meter'. A compositing pass of rising vertical displacement with a slight RGB split has its amplitude keyed per shot to how deep in memory he is: zero in honest reality, maximum at the climax. Yuasa elasticity (rubber perspective, smear frames, curling roads) is rationed to the 迷うのさ lines and the climax run so it lands as an event, not wallpaper. All story-critical reflections (mirrors, mirage twins, CRT and window glass, Snell's window, train windows) are built in compositing from SAM3 cut-outs and never left to the video model. The previous MV's halftone screen is retired; it survives only as dither inside V2's TV channels, as an Easter egg. There are no black silhouettes: every backlit face keeps a rim light plus bounce fill.
color_script:
intro: 90% navy #0C1230 darkness keyed by CRT teal #3CC6C0 and LED red #FF3B30. The one impossibility is a tiny patch of saturated noon cobalt #2A62D8 inside the glass and the mirror. Ends in a white flare.

chorus1: line-by-line alternation between memory (cobalt/white/green, pool aqua #2EC4D6) and present (navy/teal + LED red). The last bar drains to rain grey-green #7E8F8A.
verse: present navy/teal. The movie bursts in, contained in 4:3: Technicolor red #D62828, teal #1F8A8A, gold #F4B13E, sunset orange #FF8A3D. Then the leak puts cobalt noon reflections inside the navy darkness. Ends in pure black with one white dot.
chorus2: festival night, with lantern vermilion #FF5A36 and gold #FFC24B on indigo #1E2550 and beat-timed firework bursts. The flooded room carries the same bursts, so memory colours are now inside the present.
bridge1: underwater-room teal-blue #1F5E7A → dusk platform peach #FFC48A, rose #E8607E, violet #5E3C8F. The quiet bars (104–111 s) drop saturation by 30%. The tear insert is a peach sky over a violet mirror sea.
chorus3: the hottest section. Each world keeps its own palette under a shared coral #FF6B5A → magenta #D63384 grade (her red and his teal mixed), with heat haze at maximum. A single 2-frame inverted-colour flash marks the dive.
bridge2: ultramarine #0D2C6E depths with silver caustics #DDEBFF and Snell's window in warm white-gold #FFF5DA. On 陰りない her shadows go to zero (high-key).
chorus4: a soft, honest night of indigo #1B2352, sodium streetlight #FFB65C and firefly yellow-green #D8F27A. The build ramps indigo → lilac #9C8FD8 → pre-dawn peach #FFC9A3.
outro: sunrise gold #FFD98A and peach #FFB38A resolving into clear morning blue #A9D8F2, with the dawn room in warm gold. Everything is 15% less saturated than memory.
outro_hook: a clear summer morning in cobalt and white like the hook, but gentle: no overexposure, and haze only near the road. Final fade to warm white #FFF8EC.
motifs:
1. The impossible reflection (昼の映り込み): at night, surfaces show noon: the glass, the CRT, the カーブミラー, the spilled water. At the end it is resolved, not repeated. From C4-2 on, every reflection finally shows the real world (the black CRT, the dawn glass, the morning mirror).
2. 逃げ水, the fleeing water: she always stands in a mirage pool with an upside-down twin. The pool recedes when chased (C3-4) and can be walked through (O4).
3. The rising water: the room's flood level measures how far he is drowning in memory. Glass (intro) → spill (C1-6) → leak from the TV (V7) → ankle-deep (C2-2) → drowned (B1-1) → run through (C3-2) → bone dry (C4-1) → the glass upright with its ice melted (C4-2) → the glass holding the sunrise (O2).
4. Palms on glass ×3, one gesture with three meanings: erasing himself from the TV picture (V6), the last touch through the train window (B1-8), and meeting only his own reflection under the water (B2-3).
5. Circles as beat anchors: the sun, the カーブミラー, the CRT dot, a firework, the goldfish bag, ripple rings, Snell's window, the 0 of 0:00.
6. 0:00: time has stopped. It ticks to 0:01 at 150.31 s and reads 4:52 at dawn.
7. Red vs teal: her one red accent per outfit and his TV teal mix into magenta only in the climax. In her present the red is gone.
8. Screen direction as fate: her future lies screen-left (she exits left, the train leaves left, he chases left). His own life first moves screen-right in C4-4, and the final passing crosses the two directions.
9. Trains: the goodbye train (glass between them) and the train of memories (windows as film frames passing a gate).
10. Mirrored moles (hers on the left, his on the right): they are each other's reflection, and the moles tell a reflection from a person.
11. Wind chime and fan: the present's metronomes, moving on the beat.
12. 'You can walk through': her beckon in the intro TV and the hook pays off when he walks through her mirages in the outro.
camera_language:
Principle: every shot has at least two independent motion sources (character + environment, or camera + environment). Nothing is a zoom or pan across a still.
PRESENT: locked or slowly creeping dolly at tatami height (Ozu-low), 50–85 mm equivalents, shallow focus with rack-focus reveals. The same few framings return so that changes read (flood level, clock, glass). Movement comes from light, fan, water and him.
MEMORY: wide lenses skimming the asphalt and a gentle handheld drift. Telephoto compression for every mirage, because long lenses physically thicken heat haze. A 180° orbit for the 迷うのさ lines, and over-the-shoulder two-shots that keep him a step behind her.
FILM: 1950s grammar. A static two-shot in the car with rear projection behind, a slow push-in, then the pull-back out through the CRT glass into his eye.
MIRROR WORLD: dead-centre horizon, perfect symmetry, vertical crane moves into and out of water, 50% slow motion.
CLIMAX: side tracking at running speed, with the runner locked one-third from screen-right and his eye-line to the left while worlds change behind him. One beat-locked barrel roll, dolly-zoom telescoping for the unreachable mirage, and Yuasa smear frames on the snare hits.
ENDING: steadier, eye-level, long tracking shots, a single crane-up, and a 50% slow-motion side track for the passing.
Coverage: every chorus contains at least two facial close-ups, and the bridges are built on close-ups. That gives about 20 close-ups with real acting across the film (tears, a gasp, a smile forming in sleep, a breath before speaking). Faces are never crushed to silhouette; backlit shots carry rim and bounce fill.
Rhythm: cuts land on bar downbeats (the 2.963 s grid from the stem analysis). In-shot accents land on beats (0.741 s): the road brightening on kicks, channel flips, firework bursts, crossing lamps, the wind chime. In the run, smear frames land on the snare. Shots are generated at ≤5 s (81 frames @ 16 fps or 121 @ 24 fps), and A1 (5.13 s) is chained from its last frame.
transition_grammar:
Grammar rules:
(1) Each device carries exactly one meaning, so by the end of chorus 1 the audience has learned to read the film.
(2) Every transition is announced inside the outgoing shot by an anchor on its last beat: a surface, a drop, a circle or a gesture.
(3) The crossing frame lands on a bar downbeat (±1 frame), and the effect lives in the preceding beat (0.74 s).
(4) Asymmetry: drifting into memory is always soft, and waking is always a hard cut.
(5) At most one new device appears per section, and the climax only recombines devices already introduced.

1. 鏡抜け MIRROR PASS: crossing into another layer through a reflecting surface. Push into a mirror, screen or glass until its rim leaves frame, with a horizontal flip and a white flare at the plane; the reflection becomes the world. 16.98 s (night mirror → noon road), 58.46 s (into the movie).
2. 陽炎ディゾルブ HAZE DISSOLVE: present → memory. Rising displacement ramps from 0 to ~2% of frame height over the outgoing shot's last beat. The incoming shot refracts in and settles 6 frames after the downbeat. 34.76, 46.61, 82.16 and 185.87 s.
3. 覚醒カット WAKE CUT: memory → present, so reality returns abruptly. A plain hard cut on the downbeat with a warm-to-navy light jump and no effect at all. 31.79, 43.65 and 79.20 s.
4. 動作つなぎ ACTION MATCH (the Kon cut): the same feeling in another time. A gesture continues across the cut with matched screen position, direction and speed. 91.05 s (gasp underwater → breath on the platform), 111.79 s (hand sliding off the glass → first arm-swing of the run), 114.76–132.54 s (the seven run cuts), 147.35 s (swimmer surging up → boy jolting awake).
5. 定点つなぎ FIXED-POINT TIME CUT: same place, different time. Identical locked framing and a hard cut. 153.28 s (junction at midnight = C1-4's noon framing), 165.13 s (dawn room = A1), 179.94 s (morning mirror = K2).
6. 形つなぎ SHAPE MATCH: a leap in time on the beat. A round form is held at the same screen position and size across the cut. 40.68 s (mirror disc → pool ripple), 76.24 s (CRT dot → firework), 162.17 s (mirror glint → sun).
7. 波紋カット RIPPLE CUT: emotional rupture. A drop hits a surface and its ring becomes an iris that reaches the frame edge in exactly one beat. 28.83 s (her step into the mirage), ~107.3 s (her tear on the mirror sea).
8. 水面落ち SURFACE BREAK: drowning in, or surfacing from, memory. The camera crosses a waterline, and for 4 frames the image is split above and below. 88.09 s (sparks fall → bubbles rise), 135.50 s (the dive), 147.35 s (surfacing).
9. 砂嵐 STATIC BLEED: the TV pulls him back. Fine streaks (rain, sparks) sharpen into scanlines and static, and channels flip on the beats. 52.53 s (rain → static), 55.50–58.46 s (four flips), 147.35 s (her face forming in the static).
10. 種明かし PULL-BACK REVEAL: 'it was only a picture'. The camera pulls out of an image to show its frame. 8.09 s (TV → room), 64.39 s (movie → his eye).
11. 天地返し HORIZON FLIP: the reflection becomes the world. A symmetrical frame rotates 180° about the horizon over two beats with motion blur. Used only twice: 133.0–135.50 s (the dive) and 194.76–197.72 s (the finale).
12. 残像 SMEAR GHOST (Yuasa): speed beyond the body. Elastic smear frames and coloured afterimages on the snare hits fade into the next world's shapes. Climax run only.
typography:
Concept: 水鏡の歌詞, lyrics on a water mirror. Every line stands on an invisible waterline and casts its own wavering mirage beneath it, so the type performs the song's central image and never fights the picture.

Japanese: vertical 縦書き in Shippori Mincho SemiBold (ExtraBold for the four chorus lines), 64–72 px at 1080p, tracking +40. Colour depends on the layer:
• memory: ink navy #14203F with a 2 px warm halo on bright plates
• present: moon white #F2F6F8 with a 1 px RGB split on the CRT-lit scenes
• mirror world: pale silver

Chinese: Noto Serif SC Medium, ~26 px, set vertically to the left of the Japanese column with a 1 px hairline between them, at 75% opacity. It enters 6 frames after the Japanese line begins and leaves with it. The translations in the context pack are used verbatim.

English (intro, outro, outro_hook): Cormorant Garamond Italic, ~56 px, horizontal on the lower third, with the Chinese (Noto Serif SC, 24 px) beneath.

Motion: each kana or kanji 'surfaces' on its sung onset, taken from the vocal stem. It rises 14 px out of the waterline with blur going from 6 to 0 px over 4 frames. Its reflection appears beneath, flipped, at 35% opacity, gradient-faded, and displaced 3–4 px by the same heat haze as the picture (capped so it always reads). At line end the column evaporates upward (haze + fade, 8 frames) and is gone 4 frames before the next line.

Placement: in negative space opposite the subject's eye-line, never over a face, with 6% safe margins. In two-shots the column sits on his side of the frame.

In-world type is always composited, never generated:
• TV OSD, channel numbers, the EPG banner 今夜の映画劇場『MIRAGE ROAD』 and the LED clock in DotGothic16
• the movie's Japanese lines as a retro broadcast subtitle in Klee One SemiBold at the bottom of the 4:3 frame (V3–V5)

Special moments:
• 泳いでくミラー appears in mirror writing (鏡文字) and flips to right-reading on its last mora.
• 零時 glows LED red in every chorus, and in chorus 4 it ticks with the clock.
• 闇の中ではもう見えず switches off character by character as the TV dies.
• Chorus 3's last 君に幸せあげられない falls into the water with him, and its characters drift up as bubbles through bridge 2.
• 'Heat waves been fakin' me out' splits into three wavering ghost copies that rejoin.
• The title 「逃げ水」 (Zen Old Mincho Black) with HEAT WAVES (Cormorant Garamond Italic) condenses out of the reflected sky in the final flip.

Credits: Shippori Mincho Regular + Noto Serif SC, small, on white. Every font named here is already in /home/user/PPT/heatwaves_mv/assets/fonts (SIL OFL).
signature_shots: 0–5.1 s, THE IMPOSSIBLE REFLECTION: a sweating glass of ice water on the tatami at midnight holds an upside-down blazing noon sky with a cumulonimbus. A droplet slides, the ice clicks on the downbeat, and focus pulls to the sleepless boy. (Room I2V + noon-sky clip refracted into the glass mask.)

14.0–17.0 s, NOON INSIDE THE NIGHT MIRROR: from his window the camera cranes down into the カーブミラー under a streetlight. Inside it is blazing noon, and on the drop we pass through the glass as night becomes day. (Night junction push-in + convex-warped noon clip + Mirror Pass flare.)
25.9–28.8 s, SHE WALKS BACKWARDS INTO THE MIRAGE: laughing and beckoning, she steps into the 逃げ水 and the asphalt ripples around her ankles like water. The ring becomes the iris into the chorus.

37.7–40.7 s, THE MIRROR'S KIND LIE: they stand at opposite edges of the junction while the convex mirror between them shows them side by side. She leaves frame left, and her reflection lingers one beat longer. (Wide plate + cut-outs warped into the mirror, her layer delayed 0.74 s.)

46.6–49.6 s, THE ROAD CURLS INTO THE SKY: in pure Yuasa elasticity the noon road bends upward like a breaking wave and the poles sway like kelp while he keeps walking. (FLF between straight and curled keyframes that share one depth map; Blender toon road as fallback.)

61.4–64.4 s, REAR PROJECTION: in the Technicolor late-night movie the actress lowers her sunglasses to reveal 君's eyes and looks out of the TV at him. The desert highway morphs into the paddy road while the car drives on.

67.4–73.3 s, ERASING MYSELF / THE MIRAGE LEAKS: his palm covers his own image on the CRT so that she laughs alone. Then the movie's mirage pours out over the bezel and spreads across the tatami toward the lens, a noon sky inside it.

73.3–79.2 s, THE LAST DOT BECOMES A FIREWORK: the CRT dies to a single white dot in total darkness. The dot lifts off the glass, rises like a shell and bursts on the chorus downbeat into the festival, where a goldfish swims across her eye through the water bag.
88.1–91.1 s, THE DROWNED ROOM: he floats inside his own flooded room with the fan blades turning slowly, the CRT glowing underwater, the 0:00 clock submerged and bubbles leaving his lips.
105.9–108.8 s, THE TEAR BREAKS THE SKY: behind the train glass she cries without a sound. A single tear falls in slow motion onto an endless mirror sea, and her reflected face breaks into rings.

108.8–111.8 s, PALMS APART: palm to palm through the window, the train starts and the hands slide apart as sunset streaks across the glass. On the downbeat the sliding hand becomes the first arm-swing of his run.

111.8–135.5 s, THE RUN THROUGH EVERY MIRROR: one unbroken stride across eight worlds: the coast road, his own flooded room, the lantern corridor, the telescoping noon road, puddles that each hold a memory, a カーブミラー in which his sleepless self turns to look back at his running self, and a road that curls into a Möbius ribbon. It ends in a 180° Horizon Flip as he dives into the reflection. (One clean run cycle, matted with SAM3 and composited over eight generated world plates, which is also what keeps the action match perfect.)

135.5–147.4 s, SNELL'S WINDOW: underwater, the only opening to the world is a circle of light in the mirror-like surface. Inside it she sleeps on a morning train, smiling, ten months on. His palm meets only his own reflection, then her face goes shadowless in the sun and the light whites him out.

174.0–180.0 s, THE TRAIN OF MEMORIES: the morning train passes the crossing, and every window carries a different memory of her, like film running through a gate. Then the red lamps stop blinking, the gate lifts and the cicadas start.

188.8–198.7 s, PASSING IN THE SHIMMER → HORIZON FLIP: in 50% slow motion they pass each other in the heat haze, she going left and he going right, each with a small smile. The camera dips into the mirage, the world turns over, and 「逃げ水」 condenses in the reflected sky.
why_it_surpasses:
What the reference does brilliantly (judged from the frames studied):
• a unified Taisho-roman graphic system: sepia paper, gold linework, halftone glows, ornate vertical kanji and flip counters
• fusuma doors opening onto a moonlit city, and a Blender flyover of a labelled Tokyo map
• everything locked to the beat

What it does not do:
• Its people are small figures, outlined silhouettes or illustration cut-outs moved by motion graphics.
• There is little acting, almost no close-ups, and no story beyond mood.
• Motion is mostly 2D layer translation, counters and camera flyovers.
• Its wipes are decorative.

MV-A wins on the axes the client named while matching the reference's strengths:
1. Characters: two LoRA-locked leads appear in over 60 of the 66 shots with real performance: crying, a breath before speaking, a smile forming in sleep, a sprint, a swim. About 20 shots are acting close-ups, and there are zero silhouettes.
2. Motion: every shot is generated video with at least two motion sources. It also shows physical phenomena the reference never attempts: water rising in a room, rain, heat haze, fireworks over a river, underwater light, trains arriving and leaving.
3. Story: a complete arc mapped line by line, with a set-up and payoff ('you can walk through'), a reversal (his sleepless self looking back at him from the mirror), a climax (the run) and catharsis (the honest reflection, the passing).
4. Transitions that mean something: twelve named devices, each with one fixed meaning, so a Kon-style match cut surprises in the moment and makes sense in hindsight. The reference's transitions are ornament; MV-A's tell the story.
5. The reference's own strengths are matched: the typography is as carefully designed (bilingual, lyrics that cast their own mirage, in-world OSD and movie subtitles, mirror writing), and the beat discipline is the same (66 bar-locked cuts plus beat-locked in-shot accents from the stem analysis).
6. Range: eleven colour states (midnight teal, noon cobalt, Technicolor, festival vermilion, dusk rose, underwater ultramarine, sunrise gold) against the reference's single sepia register. Four strict layer codes keep it one film.
7. Image quality: 1536×864 keyframes → 720p I2V → SeedVR2 1080p → RIFE 30 fps, with compositing on top (SAM3 mattes, built reflections, haze, grading). The reference's kind of graphic precision sits on top of real animation instead of replacing it.
risks:
1. The GPU computer could not be checked. This cloud session has no GPU (4 vCPU, 15 GB RAM, ~15 GB free disk), and list_computer_folders returns no folders, so the user's computer is not connected to this session. Its VRAM, RAM, disk and ComfyUI state are unknown. Generation can't start until that computer is attached (Remote Control from the Claude desktop app, or `claude remote-control` run in the project folder on it) and /home/user/PPT/heatwaves_mv/gpu/hwcheck.sh has been run there. The plan degrades by tier, per gpu/models.py:
• ≥24 GB VRAM, or 16 GB + 64 GB RAM: the full plan (Wan 2.2 A14B + Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 + SeedVR2 7B, ~111 GB of models).
• 16 GB + 32 GB RAM: A14B without Qwen-Edit (~91 GB); identity variations come from LoRA + ControlNet only.
• ≤12 GB: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B + SeedVR2 3B (~59 GB). The storyboard stays the same, but generations are shorter (2–3 s) and more of the work moves to cut-out compositing and clip reuse.
HunyuanVideo 1.5 is the second engine for shots Wan fails on.
2. Identity can drift across 8 outfits and two looks for her (memory vs present). Mitigation: LoRAs trained on anima-base from 40–60 curated images each (turnarounds, 8 expressions, every outfit, wet and underwater). A face-similarity check runs before every I2V batch, and her present look is limited to 6 shots.
3. Reflections: video models won't keep mirrors, mirage twins or window reflections physically consistent. Every story-critical reflection is therefore built in compositing (SAM3 matte → flip/warp → haze), never left to generation.
4. Hands: the three palm-on-glass beats, the goldfish bag and the TV palm are all risky. Keep contacts static, pin start and end frames with FLF, and use ControlNet pose for the keyframes. Generate the hand as its own short clip if needed, and budget 3 retakes each.
5. The run: fast motion invites leg swaps and face drift. Generate one clean 5 s side-view run cycle on a neutral plate, cut it out and reuse it over eight world plates (which is also how the action match stays perfect). Smear frames, splashes and relighting are added in compositing.
6. FLF morphs (desert → paddies, the curling road) can turn to mush. Keep them ≤2 s and build both keyframes from the same ControlNet depth/canny map. A Blender toon-shaded road is the fallback for C1-7 and C3-7.
7. Four layers and two time periods could confuse viewers. Mitigation: strict layer codes (palette, lens, grain); costume shows time (navy T-shirt = present, white = memory, yellow = her present); the chorus rhyme; the 0:00 clock; screen direction. Cut a 480p animatic from keyframes + 4-step drafts and have three fresh viewers retell the story before final renders.
8. Water scenes: a fully flooded room rarely generates as one image, and faces distort underwater. Build these as layers (dry room plate + water surface + caustics + floating cut-out + particle bubbles), and keep underwater faces mid-size.
9. Text: models can't render readable text, so the clock, OSD, EPG banner, subtitles, timetable and title are all composited, and every prompt has 'text' in the negative.
10. Comfort and safety: heavy haze causes fatigue and motion sickness and hurts lyric legibility, so cap displacement at ~1% of frame height outside the hook and climax, and keep type haze ≤4 px. Keep luminance flashes (fireworks, CRT, channel flips, the single dive flash) to ≤3 per second for photosensitive viewers.
11. Budget and time: about 80 generated clips (66 bar shots + 4 channel inserts + plates, with 14 memory clips reused inside reflections, train windows and puddles), inside the 60–90 guide.
